description:
Update an outcome by id.

Rules:
- Partial update: pass the id plus ONLY the fields to change; everything you leave out keeps its stored value. Lists you do send (steps, tiers, entitlements) are the complete new list. Active state isn't an update field — use the archive / unarchive tools.
- Leave `steps` out and the steps are untouched. If you send it, it is the complete step list: an existing step keeps its id when you pass that `id` (from clocknext_get_outcome) or the same agentKey; leave `models` out on an existing step to keep its price; stored steps you leave out are removed.
- Step agent keys are the runtime binding — change them deliberately.

agentKey.description: The OUTCOME's own stable key — REQUIRED, unique org-wide, chars [a-z0-9._-]. Distinct from a step's agentKey and in a separate namespace: usage is still reported against a STEP's key, never this one. This identifies the outcome itself (mirrors a credit's agentKey); a rename never changes it.

marginPercent.description: Markup over the summed step base costs, as a percent (100 = double = pricePerOutcome; negative discounts, down to -100).

steps.description: 1–50 steps, each grounded by its own model mixer. Step names and agent keys must each be unique.

agentKey.description: Lowercased stable key you report this outcome step against (sent as `agentKey` when recording usage). Chars [a-z0-9._-].

id.description: UPDATE only: the existing step's id (from clocknext_get_outcome). Leave it out for a new step. A step sent without an id but with an existing step's agentKey is matched to that step anyway.

models.description: Model mixer grounding THIS step's price — REQUIRED for a new step. On update, leave it out to keep an existing step's current price. Every outcome step is an LLM step — a non-LLM, fixed-cost event is a UNIT, not an outcome step.

avgTokens.description: Average TOTAL tokens per credit / per step (input + output + cache combined).

cachePct.description: Percent that are cache-READ tokens (whole number). Default 0.

cacheWritePct.description: Percent that are cache-WRITE tokens (whole number). Default 0. Only for a model that has a cache-write price (cacheWritePrice in clocknext_list_models); must be 0 otherwise.

inputPct.description: Percent of avgTokens that are input tokens (whole number).

model.description: Enabled catalog model id from clocknext_list_models (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). Grounds the price in that model's live per-1M-token cost.

outputPct.description: Percent that are output tokens (whole number).

name: clocknext_update_outcome
title: ClockNext: update outcome
